'''''Daucus pumilus''''' is a species of plants in the carrot family [[Apiaceae]].<ref>{{Cite web |title=Daucus pumilus (L.) Hoffmanns. & Link {{!}} Plants of the World Online {{!}} Kew Science |url=http://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:841195-1 |access-date=2022-07-07 |website=Plants of the World Online |language=en}}</ref><ref>{{Cite web |last=Mifsud |first=Stephen |date=2002-08-23 |title=Pseudorlaya pumila (Small Carrot) : MaltaWildPlants.com - the online Flora of the Maltese Islands. |url=https://www.maltawildplants.com/APIA/Pseudorlaya_pumila.php |access-date=2022-03-07 |website=www.maltawildplants.com |language=en-us |archive-date=2021-12-27 |archive-url=https://web.archive.org/web/20211227175024/https://www.maltawildplants.com/APIA/Pseudorlaya_pumila.php |url-status=dead }}</ref>

== Distribution ==
This species is native to the [[Canary Islands]], but is found throughout the [[Mediterranean climate|Mediterranean]] region, including Southern Europe, North Africa and the Levant.<ref>{{Cite web |title=Daucus pumilus (L.) Hoffmanns. & Link {{!}} Plants of the World Online {{!}} Kew Science |url=https://powo.science.kew.org/taxon/urn:lsid:ipni.org:names:841195-1 |access-date=2025-03-04 |website=Plants of the World Online |language=en}}</ref>

In Maltese, it is called '''Zunnarija tar-ramel''' (Sand Carrot), and it reported to be very uncommon.<ref>{{Cite web |date=2023-06-01 |title=How To Grow Daucus pumilus {{!}} EarthOne |url=https://earthone.io/plant/daucus%20pumilus |access-date=2025-03-04 |website=earthone.io |language=en}}</ref>
